records.description: 4-10, dead last (12th) in 2021 debut → 11-3, GFL Champion in 2024
From worst record to championship in just 3 seasons
Stole Tom Campbell's original team name. Tom had to rebrand to Monti Thunderboltz.
Space Cadets — never changed. Not once. Back for Season XV with the same name.
2018 — best regular season record in GFL history. Lost the championship to Kyle O'Connell who went 9-4. The injustice lives on.

lore.title: The Winningest Pursuit
lore.text: Danny Sattler compiled a 106-80-1 record across 14 seasons. The career stands first in league history in regular-season victories, with the championship pursuit still defining the story. The strongest regular-season record was 12-2 in 2022, while the scoring peak was 1,653.16 points in 2022.

lore.title: The Two-Time Champion
lore.text: Tavis Tucker compiled a 98-63 record across 12 seasons. The championship years of 2014, 2025 secure a permanent place on the GFL trophy wall.
